info.name: RideX Backend
info.description:
RideX API. One folder per module, added as each module is built.

Auth: log in (or verify) and the test script stores {{accessToken}} automatically. Requests inherit Bearer {{accessToken}} unless marked No Auth.
Phone numbers accept 01XXXXXXXXX or +8801XXXXXXXXX. With SMS_PROVIDER=console the OTP is printed in the backend terminal.

item.name: Conversations
item.description:
**Socket.io** runs on the API origin ({{baseUrl}}). Connect with `io(baseUrl, { auth: { token } })` using POST /auth/socket-token. Every user joins their own room; the server only emits to rooms.

Client → server
- `message:send` `{ conversationId, body?, quickReplyKey?, clientId? }` ack → `{ success, statusCode, data | message }`
- `typing:start` / `typing:stop` `{ conversationId }` (throttled to one per 2s)
- `conversation:read` `{ conversationId }` ack → `{ success, data }`

Server → client
- `message:new` `{ conversation, message }`: `conversation` is the recipient's own view (unreadCount, side, counterpart)
- `conversation:read` `{ conversationId, readerId, readAt }`: messages with createdAt ≤ readAt are seen
- `typing` `{ conversationId, userId, isTyping }`
- `chat:unread` `{ total, conversations }`
- `block:changed` `{ userId, blockedByMe? | blockedMe? }`
- `notification:new` (notification row) · `notification:unread` `{ total }`
- `auth:error` `{ message }`, sent before the server disconnects a socket whose user was blocked or signed out

Chat is limited to BUYER, SELLER, DEALER, DEALER_STAFF and INSPECTOR. Sending (socket + REST) is limited by CHAT_MESSAGE_RATE_LIMIT per minute; new conversations by CHAT_NEW_CONVERSATION_LIMIT per hour. `clientId` (uuid) makes a retried send idempotent.

request.description: Chat roles. One thread per buyer per listing: 201 when created, 200 when the existing thread is reused (the message is added to it). Needs `body` or a buyer `quickReplyKey`. New threads only for APPROVED listings, never your own, never when either side has blocked the other.
Chat roles. Filters: `side=buying|selling` (default both), `archived=true`, `unread=true`, `searchTerm` (listing title or the other person's name). Sorted by last message. Page meta.
Chat roles. `{ total, conversations }` for badges.

item.name: Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications are pushed live over Socket.io (`notification:new`, `notification:unread`). Email copies are queued (BullMQ) and respect preferences. Categories: MESSAGES (unread-message email digest, sent CHAT_EMAIL_DELAY_MINUTES after a message if still unread and the user is offline), LISTINGS, PRICE_ALERTS, REVIEWS, ACCOUNT (always on).

item.name: Dashboard
item.description: Per-role overview stats for the dashboard home pages. Admin and moderator overviews are cached in Redis for `DASHBOARD_CACHE_SECONDS` (default 60).

request.description: SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN. Users by role/status, listings by status, reports, pending verifications, chats, daily series (users, submitted, approved, reports, conversations), top brands, listings by division, recent audit activity (admins never see super admin entries). Counts include `change` vs the previous period (null when the previous period was 0). `range=7d|30d|90d` (default 30d, unknown values fall back to 30d). Days are local days in `TIMEZONE`; `series` has one point per day with 0 for empty days.

MODERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. Queue sizes, my approvals/rejections (from the audit log) and reports closed, average submit-to-approve hours, open reports by reason and type, the 5 oldest items in each queue. `verifications` is null for moderators. `range=7d|30d|90d` (default 30d, unknown values fall back to 30d). Days are local days in `TIMEZONE`; `series` has one point per day with 0 for empty days.

SELLER, DEALER. My listings by status, views, saves, chats, unread, chat-to-sale rate, rating and verification status, daily series (chats, saves, sold), top 5 listings, listings expiring within 7 days, latest reviews. `range=7d|30d|90d` (default 30d, unknown values fall back to 30d). Days are local days in `TIMEZONE`; `series` has one point per day with 0 for empty days.

BUYER, DEALER_STAFF, INSPECTOR. Saved (available/unavailable), recently viewed, active chats and unread, my reports, reviews written, verification status, daily series (saves, viewed, messages), latest saved, saved by brand. `range=7d|30d|90d` (default 30d, unknown values fall back to 30d). Days are local days in `TIMEZONE`; `series` has one point per day with 0 for empty days.
MODERATOR, ADMIN, SUPER_ADMIN. `{ listings, reports, verifications }` for the sidebar badges; `verifications` is null for moderators.

item.name: Offers
item.description: Price negotiation inside chat. Roles: BUYER, SELLER, DEALER, DEALER_STAFF, INSPECTOR. Each offer or counter appears as an OFFER card in the conversation; accept/decline/withdraw/expire post a SYSTEM notice. Socket event `offer:updated` carries the live card state.

request.description: Buyer only (not the listing's seller). Listing must be APPROVED and negotiable. Amount between OFFER_MIN_PERCENT of the price and the asking price. One open offer per conversation; none after an accepted one. Creates the conversation if needed. Expires after OFFER_EXPIRY_HOURS.

Offers I made or received. Filters: `as=buyer|seller`, `status`, `listingId`, `conversationId`, `searchTerm` (listing title, names). Sort: `createdAt`, `amount`, `expiresAt`. COUNTERED rows are hidden unless `status=COUNTERED`, so each negotiation shows its latest offer. Every row has `allowedActions` for the caller.
Participants only (404 otherwise). `history` lists every offer in the same conversation, oldest first.

The recipient only, while PENDING and before expiresAt. Seller: above the buyer's offer and below their own last counter (first counter: up to the asking price). Buyer: above their last offer and below the seller's counter. At most OFFER_MAX_ROUNDS per negotiation. The countered offer becomes COUNTERED.

The recipient only, while PENDING, before expiresAt and while the listing is APPROVED. The listing is not reserved: other buyers keep their offers and are told another offer was accepted. Two parallel accepts: one 200, one 409.
The recipient only, while PENDING. Reason is optional and shown in the chat notice.
The proposer only, while PENDING (also after expiresAt, until the expiry job runs).

item.name: Test Rides
item.description: Sellers (SELLER, DEALER) set weekly hours and blocked dates; buyers (chat roles) book a free slot. Times are wall-clock in TIMEZONE (default Asia/Dhaka). Capacity is per seller across listings. Each booking is a TEST_RIDE card in chat; status changes post a SYSTEM notice. Socket event `testRide:updated` carries the live card state. Reminders go out 24h and 2h before a confirmed ride.

request.description: SELLER / DEALER. Weekly rules, upcoming blocked dates, and the settings the editor needs (timezone, slot lengths, booking days, lead hours).

SELLER / DEALER. Replaces the whole week. `listingId` null = default for all my listings; rules with a listingId replace the defaults for that listing. Ranges on the same day and scope must not overlap. Slot length 15/30/45/60/90/120 min, capacity 1–10. Existing bookings are kept.
SELLER / DEALER. A local calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD), today up to a year ahead. Existing bookings that day stay active; `affectedBookings` tells how many.
SELLER / DEALER, own dates only (404 otherwise).

Public. Free slots per local day, from today up to TEST_RIDE_BOOKING_DAYS ahead, starting at least TEST_RIDE_MIN_LEAD_HOURS from now. Optional `from` / `to` (YYYY-MM-DD) narrow the range. `hasAvailability: false` when the seller has no hours. Saves the first slot as `slotStartsAt`.

Buyer (not the listing's seller), listing APPROVED. `startsAt` must be one of the free slots (re-checked under a lock; 409 if taken). One upcoming booking per buyer per listing. Creates the conversation if needed. Expires if not confirmed by its start time.

Filters: `as=buyer|seller`, `status`, `upcoming=true` (requested/confirmed, not over; soonest first) or `upcoming=false` (past or closed; newest first), `listingId`, `searchTerm`. Each row has `allowedActions` for the caller.
Participants only (404 otherwise).
Seller only, REQUESTED and not started. The optional note (where to meet) is shown to the buyer. Schedules the 24h and 2h reminders.
Seller only, REQUESTED. Reason required.
Buyer or seller, REQUESTED or CONFIRMED and not started. Reason required. Frees the slot.
Seller only, CONFIRMED and already started.
Seller only, CONFIRMED and already started.

Public for APPROVED and SOLD listings. The owner and staff also see unpublished ones (send the token). Compares against the same model, the same condition group (new, or used + reconditioned), and live listings or ones sold within PRICE_INSIGHT_SOLD_LOOKBACK_DAYS. Tiers: year ±1 and mileage ±50%, then year ±2, then year ±3. The first tier with PRICE_INSIGHT_MIN_SAMPLE listings (after outliers are removed) is used. rating: GOOD_DEAL (≤ −PRICE_INSIGHT_DEAL_PERCENT% from the median), FAIR, HIGH (≥ +%), or INSUFFICIENT_DATA with reason NO_MODEL | TOO_FEW_COMPARABLES. Cached per listing and price.

Public. ids = 1–4 comma-separated listing UUIDs; columns come back in the order sent. All listings must share one vehicle type (400 otherwise). Live and sold listings only: ids that are gone come back in missingIds instead of an error. Returns listings (card fields, description, color, priceInsight), specRows (one per attribute with a value: label, group, unit, values per column, isDifferent), and highlights (lowestPrice, lowestMileage, newestYear, bestDeal: listing ids, ties shared, empty when all are equal).

BUYER / SELLER / DEALER / DEALER_STAFF / INSPECTOR. query = the search page's URL params (same keys as GET /search/listings, spec.* included). Paging, sorting and unknown keys are dropped; lists are sorted, so the same filters in another order are the same search (409 when already saved). At least one filter is required, and filters are checked with the search rules (400). name is optional (generated from the filters, e.g. "Yamaha · R15 V4 · Under BDT 500,000"). alertFrequency INSTANT (default) | DAILY | OFF, notifyPriceDrops (default true). At most SAVED_SEARCH_MAX_PER_USER per user. Saves the id as savedSearchId.

BUYER / SELLER / DEALER / DEALER_STAFF / INSPECTOR. Newest first, ?searchTerm= filters by name. Each item has summary (readable filter chips), searchUrl (frontend results link), newMatchesCount (live matches since lastViewedAt) and totalMatchesCount. Saves the first id as savedSearchId.

BUYER / SELLER / DEALER / DEALER_STAFF / INSPECTOR. Pass the search page's params. Returns { savedSearch: { id, name, alertFrequency, notifyPriceDrops } | null } — the search page uses it for the "Saved" state.

BUYER / SELLER / DEALER / DEALER_STAFF / INSPECTOR. Owner only (404 otherwise). The saved search plus its 20 latest matches: kind NEW_LISTING | PRICE_DROP, oldPrice/newPrice for drops, matchedAt, isNew, and the listing card (sold listings keep their status).
BUYER / SELLER / DEALER / DEALER_STAFF / INSPECTOR. Rename, change alertFrequency, or turn price-drop alerts on/off. At least one field.
BUYER / SELLER / DEALER / DEALER_STAFF / INSPECTOR. Sets lastViewedAt to now, which clears newMatchesCount. The frontend calls it when the detail page opens.
BUYER / SELLER / DEALER / DEALER_STAFF / INSPECTOR. Deletes the search and its matches.
